# IntegratedSensingFusion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A military-oriented framework that combines heterogeneous sensor data (e.g., radar, EO/IR, signals) into a unified situational awareness picture for real-time decision support. Enables iNEST systems to process multi-modal sensory streams in-network, reducing latency and improving battlefield cognition without relying on centralized cloud processing.
